description: Primary-source review of proposed SCRI data and method candidates. No row represents downloaded, licensed, quality-controlled, or admitted training data.
admission_requirements: Resolve exact immutable artifact revision, checksum, access authorization, and data/model reuse terms before download or use.
Verify sample-level organism, assay, donor/animal or pool, study, intervention, timepoint, units, processing, and outcome provenance.
Record pairing only at the demonstrated level: same cell, same specimen, same donor, matched condition, or unpaired.
Keep experimental measurements, simulations, and model imputations distinct.
Deduplicate source cohorts across aggregate corpora and freeze donor/study/intervention holdouts before training.
Use an objective compatible with the assay and numeric representation; do not reinterpret FPKM as counts or bulk as single-cell data.
Require relevant evaluation and implementation checks before accepting model-derived targets or planner-generated outcomes.
coverage_gaps: No protein measurement dataset has been verified among these named candidates.
No experimental membrane-voltage dataset has been verified among these named candidates; BETSE is a simulator.
Cross-assay same-cell pairing is not established by a shared study title or multi-omic publication.
A typed biological graph is a design representation; causal edges and outcomes need their own evidence.
Animal and cell-culture regeneration evidence does not establish human clinical efficacy.

sources.title: Maintenance of Fibroblast Identity During Cardiac Reprogramming and Heart Repair [RNA-seq]
sources.pairing_scope: Bulk RNA samples; study/condition alignment with GSE305166 does not establish same-cell or same-sample RNA/ATAC pairing.
notes: GEO reports 18 bulk RNA samples: siControl or siChst7, days 0/1/3, three biological replicates per condition and time.
The system is iMGT (Mef2c, Gata4, Tbx5)-Myh6-eGFP mouse embryonic fibroblast cardiac reprogramming.
Processed counts_Romero.txt.gz (663.7 KB) is listed; raw reads are linked through SRA. Neither artifact was downloaded or inspected.
GEO links the 2026 Nature Communications publication PMID 42469251 and BioProject PRJNA1304539; public release 2025-08-19, metadata updated 2026-09-23.
Mouse reprogramming outcomes do not establish clinical efficacy. Data reuse terms and sample-level provenance remain unresolved.

sources.title: Maintenance of Fibroblast Identity During Cardiac Reprogramming and Heart Repair [ATAC-seq]
sources.pairing_scope: Bulk ATAC samples; related RNA study GSE305170 provides study/condition context, not demonstrated joint single-cell multiome pairing.
notes: GEO reports four bulk ATAC samples, two biological replicates per siControl or siChst7 condition.
The experiment concerns day-one MGT cardiac reprogramming in the mouse embryonic fibroblast system.
Processed narrowPeak files and raw SRA links are listed. Peak calls are not raw fragment matrices and require an explicit adapter.
GEO links PMID 42469251 and BioProject PRJNA1304533; public release 2025-08-19, metadata updated 2026-09-23.
No data artifact, sample pairing, or reuse license has been validated locally.

sources.title: Macrophages suppress cardiac reprogramming of fibroblasts in vivo via IFN-mediated intercellular self-stimulating circuit (RNA-Seq)
sources.pairing_scope: Bulk RNA comparisons across in-vivo and in-vitro reprogramming; not paired single-cell measurements.
notes: GEO reports eight samples: in vivo or in vitro, one or two weeks, with two replicates per setting and time.
The processed gene_fpkm_group.xls.gz file is FPKM-normalized expression. It must not be treated as raw counts for a count likelihood.
Raw SRA data are linked; raw-read reprocessing is a separate, unperformed curation step.
GEO links PMID 38530808 and BioProject PRJNA1086465. The broader GSE261309 study includes CUT&Tag under a separate accession.
The experimental system is mouse fibroblast reprogramming, including transplanted cells after myocardial infarction; it is not human clinical evidence.
Reuse license, biological-replicate identity, processing compatibility, and complete sample metadata remain unresolved.

sources.title: Direct In Vivo Cardiac Reprogramming as a Novel Therapeutic Strategy for Chronic Myocardial Infarction [scRNA-Seq]
sources.pairing_scope: Dissociated single-cell RNA from non-cardiomyocytes; no paired ATAC, protein, voltage, or spatial measurement is established by this accession.
notes: GEO reports four samples: Sham, Ctrl-MI, TTg-MI, and Sham2, from mouse hearts in a chronic myocardial-infarction study.
The accession describes non-cardiomyocytes three months after myocardial infarction; it must not be relabeled a cardiomyocyte expression cohort.
Processed CSV files and raw SRA links are listed; animal pooling and independent biological-replicate counts require a sample-level audit.
The publication is Tani et al., Direct Reprogramming Improves Cardiac Function and Reverses Fibrosis in Chronic Myocardial Infarction, Circulation (PMID 36503256).
GEO public release was 2022-12-12; data reuse terms are not verified. Mouse results do not establish clinical efficacy.
intended_roles: cardiac stromal and immune context candidate

sources.title: Spatiotemporal Single-Cell Roadmap of Human Skin Wound Healing (Single-cell-Wound)
sources.pairing_scope: Dissociated RNA from donors 3/4/5 over intact skin and days 1/7/30. Donors 3/4 overlap GSE241124; donor/time correspondence is not same-cell pairing.
notes: GEO reports 12 samples spanning three donors and four wound-healing states.
Processed data and metadata are publicly listed in GEO; raw reads are controlled through EGA accession EGAS50000000571.
A GEO archive named RAW.tar contains submitted processed files and is not evidence that controlled raw sequencing reads are publicly available.
Group related RNA/spatial samples by donor and study before splitting to prevent cross-modality donor leakage.
GEO public release was 2024-09-04, updated 2025-01-07; linked PMIDs include 39468077 and 39729995.
Neither controlled access authorization nor data reuse rights have been established.

sources.title: Spatiotemporal Single-Cell Roadmap of Human Skin Wound Healing (Spatial)
sources.pairing_scope: Spatial expression and positions within tissue sections; donors 1/2/3/4 over intact skin and days 1/7/30. Related dissociated RNA is not same-cell paired.
notes: GEO reports 16 samples spanning four donors and four wound-healing states.
Processed H5/ZIP files and metadata are publicly listed; raw reads are controlled in EGA EGAS50000000571.
Donors 3/4 overlap GSE241132. Split jointly by donor and study before any RNA/spatial alignment.
Spatial observations do not imply paired ATAC, protein, or voltage measurements. Image availability and expression-image registration require artifact-level verification.
GEO public release was 2024-09-04, updated 2025-01-07; linked PMIDs include 39366968, 39468077, and 39729995.
Access authorization and data reuse rights remain unresolved.

sources.title: Multi-omic analysis reveals retinoic acid molecular drivers for fibrosis and regenerative repair in skin fibrosis [scATAC-seq]
sources.pairing_scope: Single-cell ATAC arm of a broader multi-assay study; same-cell RNA/ATAC or spatial pairing is not established for this accession.
notes: This accession contains scATAC data from a mouse bleomycin-induced skin-fibrosis study, not all modalities reported in the paper.
GEO reports four samples: unwounded and postoperative days 12/21/28.
The broader study includes RNA and Visium assays; its CYP26B1-inhibition RNA arm must not be transferred as a treatment annotation to this ATAC arm without sample evidence.
Processed BED/MTX/TSV files and raw SRA links are listed; pooling and biological-replicate structure require validation.
The linked publication is Griffin et al., Cell Stem Cell (2025), PMID 40816279; BioProject PRJNA1165329.
Sibling accessions GSE278169 and GSE277998 are unresolved leads from the broader study, not verified assay coverage in this catalog.
GEO public release was 2025-08-13, updated 2026-02-18. Reuse rights remain unresolved.

sources.title: Characterization of regeneration initiating cells during Xenopus laevis tail regeneration
sources.pairing_scope: Mixed-assay SuperSeries. Resolve child accessions and sample relationships before assigning assay pairing.
notes: GEO reports 63 samples across children GSE245312 (single-cell RNA), GSE245313 (spatial), GSE245317 (bulk RNA 1), and GSE245318 (bulk RNA 2).
Regenerating and refractory tadpole-tail contexts span minute/hour/day post-amputation states; normalize temporal units from sample metadata.
The processed archive lists heterogeneous expression, image, and metadata formats. Listed images do not establish registered expression-image pairs.
Do not ingest the SuperSeries as one homogeneous count matrix or count it again after admitting its children.
GEO links PMID 39350302 and BioProject PRJNA1027815; public release 2023-11-30, updated 2024-10-15.
Cross-species regeneration transfer requires explicit evaluation. Reuse rights and raw-data access have not been verified.

sources.title: neuroendocrine control of planarian regeneration (Spatial transcriptome)
sources.pairing_scope: Spatial transcriptomics from asexual CIW4 planarians; Stereo-seq and Visium arms are separate unless specimen correspondence is documented.
notes: The accession describes intact, amputated, and RNAi-related regeneration contexts, including tail samples.
Stereo-seq times include 0 h, 12 h, 1.5 d, 3 d, 5 d, and 10 d. The Visium overview and a raw-mixing note disagree on 3 d versus 2.5 d; resolve this before assigning time labels.
The processed listing includes expression and image files; anatomical registration and expression-image linkage remain unverified.
GEO was submitted in 2022 and became public on 2025-09-01; the retrieved record has no publication citation, so peer-reviewed validation is unresolved.
The referenced transcriptome is GSE72389_smed_20140614.fa.gz; identifier mapping and assembly compatibility require explicit curation.
Raw-data accessibility, reuse terms, replicate structure, and outcome labels remain unverified.

sources.title: Arc Virtual Cell Atlas collection index
sources.pairing_scope: Collection index spanning observational and perturbational resources; no universal same-cell, donor, or multimodal pairing.
notes: The collection includes Tahoe-100M, scBaseCount, and Virtual Cell Challenge data; the umbrella is not an independent cohort.
Do not count the umbrella and its component datasets as separate training examples.
Collection size and releases change. Select immutable component releases and record artifact checksums before curation.
The repository describes Google Cloud Marketplace subscription and billing-project requirements for download credits; public metadata does not establish cost-free or authorized artifact access.
No billing project, subscription, bulk download, or cloud transfer was initiated.
Organism coverage, input-study licenses, and permitted downstream use must be resolved per component and source study.

sources.title: Tahoe-100M perturbational single-cell expression collection
sources.pairing_scope: Drug-perturbed cancer cell-line RNA profiles; treatment/control relationships require sample metadata and are not same-cell longitudinal pairs.
notes: The official Atlas page describes approximately 60,000 drug experiments, 50 cancer models, and more than 1,100 drugs.
Tahoe is an Arc Atlas component and must be deduplicated against aggregate Atlas ingestion.
Hold out interventions and cellular contexts to evaluate transfer; random cell splits alone cannot establish generalization.
Dose, duration, replicate, treatment/control mapping, exact release, and artifact checksums remain unverified.
The Atlas repository describes billing-project and Marketplace download requirements. Artifact access and data reuse license remain unresolved.
Cancer cell-line perturbations do not establish regeneration outcomes or measured bioelectric states.

sources.title: scBaseCount uniformly processed public single-cell RNA collection
sources.pairing_scope: Aggregated dissociated RNA studies with heterogeneous source metadata; no universal pairing or longitudinal correspondence.
notes: The retrieved official README reports more than 502 million cells from 27 organisms and 75 tissues; the collection is continuously updated.
Automated discovery and metadata extraction with uniform SRA processing do not replace source metadata audit.
Select an immutable release and preserve source accession, donor/animal, study, batch, and processing provenance for every admitted item.
Organism membership must be resolved from that release; this catalog does not enumerate unverified taxa.
Deduplicate source studies and observations against CellxGene-derived corpora, SpatialCorpus-110M, and other Atlas inputs before splitting.
Public hosting and uniform processing do not establish downstream reuse rights or scientific suitability. Actual download access remains unverified.

sources.title: Arc Virtual Cell Challenge 2025 perturbation dataset and benchmark splits
sources.pairing_scope: Perturbational single-cell RNA in the H1 human embryonic stem-cell context; treatment/control samples are not same-cell pre/post measurements.
notes: The official Atlas repository documents the Virtual Cell Challenge component and train/validation/test resources.
The 2025 evaluation splits are now public; training on them removes their status as an unseen evaluation set.
Preserve intervention and replicate groupings and freeze benchmark exclusions before assembling pretraining mixtures.
Do not merge challenge years as one benchmark; later challenges can change cell contexts and evaluation rules.
Exact artifacts, releases, permissions, and license terms remain unresolved. Cloud download access has not been tested.

sources.title: SpatialCorpus-110M dissociated and spatial RNA corpus
sources.pairing_scope: Dissociated and spatial RNA datasets; spatial observations have assay-local positions, while dissociated cells are not generally paired to the spatial cells.
notes: The primary paper reports 57.06 million dissociated and 53.83 million spatial observations across 73 tissues and more than 6,000 donors or replicates.
The source paper describes RNA assays including CosMx, ISS, MERFISH, and Xenium; this does not establish ATAC, protein, or voltage measurements.
The authors state that images and segmentation masks were not collected or curated for this corpus.
Dissociated inputs include CellxGene Census and other sources. Deduplicate overlapping corpora at source-study and observation level.
Retain original donor/replicate, study, organism, assay, gene-panel, and coordinate provenance. Inferred spatial context is not a measured coordinate.
The article license does not establish component-dataset or model-weight licenses. Corpus reuse terms, revision, access, and artifact hashes remain unverified.

sources.title: STATE perturbation-response model reference
sources.pairing_scope: Model predictions are inferred responses, not experimental paired measurements or new biological ground truth.
notes: The repository documents cellular perturbation-response modeling; architecture or API compatibility alone does not authorize model use.
The model license is the Arc State Model Non-Commercial License, dated 2025-06-23, with a separate acceptable-use policy.
The license covers derivatives including fine-tuning, distillation, additional training, and integration as a prior. Commercial and sponsored-R&D restrictions require resolution for intended use.
Arc describes an opt-in commercial evaluation arrangement requiring confirmation; no eligibility, opt-in, or approval is assumed.
Code, weights, datasets, and outputs have distinct terms. This entry records the model restriction and does not grant dataset rights.
No checkpoint, generated target, embedding, or prediction was downloaded, executed, or admitted.

sources.title: Nicheformer: a foundation model for single-cell and spatial omics
sources.pairing_scope: Predicted niche context from an RNA/spatial model is inferred and must not be relabeled measured spatial ground truth.
notes: Peer-reviewed Nature Methods article published 2025-10-30, volume 22, pages 2525-2538.
The method supports RNA/spatial representation learning; it does not validate ATAC/protein/voltage integration or regenerative efficacy.
Official theislab/nicheformer code declares BSD-3-Clause; that does not resolve dataset or pretrained-weight rights.
Checkpoint integration requires an immutable revision, separate model/data license review, and training/evaluation overlap audit.
No model artifact or dataset was downloaded.

sources.title: BioElectric Tissue Simulation Engine (BETSE)
sources.pairing_scope: Fields generated within one simulation are paired computational states, not paired experimental voltage, omics, or regeneration measurements.
notes: BETSE is a two-dimensional multiphysics simulator for bioelectric and biochemical tissue dynamics, including electrodiffusion and related processes.
Primary methods paper: Pietak and Levin (2016), Exploring Instructive Physiological Signaling with the Bioelectric Tissue Simulation Engine.
The code repository declares BSD-2-Clause; code licensing does not establish rights to external inputs, calibration data, or resulting labeled assets.
No simulation was executed and no synthetic records exist in this catalog. Future artifacts need simulator version, configuration, geometry, units, seed, and calibration evidence.
Keep simulated, experimentally measured, and model-imputed bioelectric outcomes in distinct provenance classes and evaluation strata.
Mechanistic simulation does not establish biological or clinical efficacy; experimental validation must be assessed separately.
intended_roles: separately labeled synthetic bioelectric test domain

sources.title: Forest-of-Thought: Scaling Test-Time Compute for Enhancing LLM Reasoning
sources.pairing_scope: Algorithmic reasoning reference; no biological measurements or paired assay data.
notes: Bi et al., ICML 2025, Proceedings of Machine Learning Research 267:4253-4267.
This supports an LLM test-time reasoning approach, not a validated biological intervention planner or regeneration outcome model.
A project-specific typed-graph search or planner needs an independently specified objective and evaluation.
Implementation compatibility and code/model license are unverified; no artifact was obtained.

sources.title: A theory of continuous generative flow networks
sources.pairing_scope: Mathematical sampling-method reference; no biological measurements or paired assay data.
notes: Lahlou et al., ICML 2023, Proceedings of Machine Learning Research 202:18269-18300.
The paper develops GFlowNets over continuous and hybrid state spaces for amortized sampling from unnormalized targets.
This theory does not establish that a proposed biological reward is valid, calibrated, causal, or experimentally achievable.
An adaptation needs explicit state/action support, a justified reward, sampling diagnostics, and independent outcome validation.
Code and artifact licenses are unverified; no model or dataset was obtained.

sources.title: Tensor Programs V: Tuning Large Neural Networks via Zero-Shot Hyperparameter Transfer
sources.pairing_scope: Neural-network parametrization and width-transfer reference; no biological data pairing.
notes: The primary paper studies hyperparameter transfer across widths under maximal update parametrization, not guaranteed transfer across depth, objectives, datasets, or architecture changes.
Official implementation guidance requires compatible base/delta shapes, width-dependent parameter metadata, initialization, readout, and optimizer handling.
Coordinate checks over multiple widths and training updates are prerequisites for interpreting a transfer sweep; configuration generation alone is not readiness.
Pin the implementation revision and freeze architecture, objective, data manifest, and optimization conventions for transfer comparisons.
Repository code licensing does not confer training-data or checkpoint rights.
No training run or sweep was launched by this source review.
